## Analysis overview

Selects safety vital-sign records with baseline values, identifies Week 24 and end-of-treatment observations, and calculates descriptive statistics for change from baseline by measure, position, visit, and treatment.

## ADaM datasets

- `ADVS`
- `ADSL`

## Key ADaM variables

- `PARAM`: vital-sign measure
- `ATPT`: measurement position/time
- `BASE`: baseline value
- `CHG`: change from baseline
- `AVISIT`: analysis visit
- `SAFFL`: safety flag
- `TRTP`: planned treatment
- `ARM in ADSL`: denominator treatment.
